reviewer.method: Independent frame-exact review of output/film.mp4 (sha256 bd2f1e4e..., verified) against output/film-reference/evidence.json's 43-shot plan (read fresh for this round; all 43 shot [start,end] windows re-derived from this file, not carried over from findings-film-v5.json). observations.detail: Full 202.3s runtime confirmed via ffprobe against output/film.mp4; 43 shots' [start,end] from evidence.json tile exactly end-to-end from 0 to 202.288/202.3 with no gaps or overlaps found when diffing consecutive shot boundaries.
